verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single first-party line saying Stripe offers revenue recognition with 'automated support for global accounting standards.' This points to a recognition capability, but the pack does not show it works directly on Billing data or what it produces. Missing for 10: explicit ASC 606 / IFRS 15 support, deferred revenue schedules, audit-ready recognition reports, a documented link from Billing data to recognition output, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
